title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Varthana Finance Pvt. Ltd. \| Hiring Relationship Managers (Field Sales)**

Hi,

We are hiring Relationship Managers (Field Sales) at Varthana Finance Pvt. Ltd.

Open Locations

1\.Sambalpur,Odisha

2\.Nagpur

3\.Rajkot

4\.Manipuri,Uttarpradesh

5\.Faridabad

**About Varthana**

Varthana is one of India's leading Education Finance NBFCs, supporting affordable private schools through financial solutions. We help schools enhance their infrastructure by funding classrooms, buildings, smart classes, laboratories, school buses, furniture, uniforms, and other educational facilities.

**Role: Relationship Manager (Field Sales)**

**Key Responsibilities**

Meet school owners and educational institutions to generate business.

Visit 8–10 schools daily to promote Varthana's School Loan products.

Build and maintain strong customer relationships.

Complete KYC, documentation, customer verification, and loan processing.

Travel within the assigned territory (up to 100 km daily).

Achieve a monthly business target of ₹50 Lakhs.

**Mandatory Eligibility**

✔ Graduate with 2\+ years of relevant field sales experience (Home Loan/LAP/Mortgage/NBFC/BFSI preferred).

✔ Age below 40 years (Preferred: 30–40 years).

✔ Own two\-wheeler with a valid driving licence.

✔ Physically fit for extensive field sales.

✔ Willing to travel up to 100 km daily.

✔ Fluent in the local language and familiar with the local market.

✔ Stable career history with a genuine reason for job change.

✔ Experience in Secured Loans preferred.

✔ Good CIBIL score with no overdue above ₹10,000\.

**Benefits**

Attractive Fixed Salary \+ Unlimited Incentives

Travel \& Expense Reimbursement

PF, Health \& Life Insurance

Learning \& Development Programs

Excellent Career Growth \& Internal Promotion Opportunities

Supportive work culture with continuous training and mentoring

**Interested**?

Share your updated CV at whatsapp 7306379344  
Complete the screening form:

https://forms.gle/2yoN6AYzn46j5Y3q9

We look forward to connecting with you!

HR Team \| Varthana Finance Pvt. Ltd.

Not interested? Please refer this opportunity to your friends, colleagues, or relatives who may be a good fit.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹280,000\.00 \- ₹450,000\.00 per year
